verses.restored: O come, let us sing to YHWH: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

familiar.text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

modern.text: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!

original.text: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ

verses.restored: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

familiar.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

modern.text: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.

original.text: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ

verses.restored: For YHWH is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

familiar.text: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

modern.text: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

original.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

familiar.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

modern.text: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ

verses.restored: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

familiar.text: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

modern.text: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

original.text: אֲשֶׁר ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ

verses.restored: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before YHWH our maker.

familiar.text: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

modern.text: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.

original.text: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ

verses.restored: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture and the flock of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,

familiar.text: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

notes.title: Today, if you hear
notes.body: Hebrews 3–4 later builds an extended interpretation around this line and the wilderness generation. The psalm’s own setting remains a communal call to listen rather than harden the heart.

modern.text: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,

original.text: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ

verses.restored: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

familiar.text: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

modern.text: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,

original.text: אַל תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

familiar.text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

modern.text: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי

verses.restored: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

familiar.text: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

modern.text: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”

original.text: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי

verses.restored: To whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

familiar.text: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

modern.text: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”

original.text: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל מְנוּחָתִֽי

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: The wilderness warning must not become a tool for coercive religion or victim-blaming; later Hebrews reception should remain distinct from the psalm’s own voice.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
